participation.context: Paid one hundred shillings, took forty-two from the canvas, and kept the names off the way home.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the pages ruled, and not reported at his door

story.body: You settled each page to the penny and bought silence at the Henley Street door. The belt failed at the shoemaker, so the forty-two shillings came out of the canvas. Eighteen stayed in the cloth.

relations.note: the pages ruled, and not reported at his door

title: Paid the three shops and opened the canvas

participation.context: Called it bread, and did not mend the joke.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Named the walk, and priced it as eight loaves.
participation.name: Hamnet Sadler

story.body: Sadler stood in the shop that was not owed. You let eight loaves stand for the morning, and you did not explain it.

title: Let eight loaves stand for the morning
